SYMPTOM: Fatal error: Unexpectedly found nil while implicitly unwrapping an Optional value — test crashes even though it was 'skipped'
CAUSE: `XCTSkip` throws from `setUp`, which skips the test body BUT tearDown still runs. If tearDown calls methods on implicitly-unwrapped `sut` that was never assigned (because setUp threw), it crashes.
FIX: In tearDown, guard against nil before using sut:
  ```swift
  override func tearDownWithError() throws {
    guard sut != nil else { return }  // XCTSkip may have thrown in setUp
    sut.disconnect()
    sut = nil
  }
  ```
PREVENT: Always use `guard sut != nil else { return }` at the top of tearDown when setUp can throw XCTSkip
